items.title: Constellation Energy Has Faded Since Last December: Why BMO Sees 23% Upside
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBMO Capital raised its Constellation Energy price target to $335 from $316 and kept its Outperform rating, about 23% above the stock’s Nov. 17 close.

items.title: Steve Eisman Says the Biggest AI Risk Is Local Governments Slowing Data Center Construction
items.summary: Steve Eisman says the real threat to AI is not chips but zoning boards, and a full freeze could tip the country into recession overnight. One kind of company could still profit if building slows, and it may surprise you.

items.title: Bernstein Cut Its Constellation Energy Target to $293. It Still Sees 5% Upside
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBernstein cut its Constellation Energy price target to $293 from $296 and kept its Outperform rating, leaving about 5% upside. The stock is 27% below its December 2025 high after a soft 2026 outlook, a jump in debt and a midterm scare over data centers.

items.title: Constellation Energy vs. Vistra: Which Utilities Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: Vistra trades at a lower forward P/E than Constellation Energy, but its heavier debt load and thinner free cash flow raise questions worth weighing.
